hypothesis: Normal adaptive feedback provides useful post-change learning beyond passive feedback decay without exceeding2pp additional old-fact loss against the decay-only control.
primary_metric: Per-seed equal mean of novel CE at steps544..768 every32 and drift CE at1056..1280 every32 (16 checkpoints); arithmetic mean of three paired relative CE reductions.
minimum_useful_effect: Mean relative CE reduction>=5%; every seed>=0%.
success_rule: All finite/fidelity/data/replay/preservation gates, mean paired CE reduction>=5% and no negative seed; adaptive_fifo old-window and final-old accuracy at most2pp worse than decay_fifo in every seed. This is a narrow mechanism gate; normal-versus-frozen retention remains separately visible.
futility_rule: No tuning or added seeds. Stop on fidelity, preservation, pilot numerical failure or exhausted budget; preserve all failed arms. Main arm failure invalidates the primary gate. Retention or effect failure means no promotion.

authorization.user_approval_reference: User: Alright, looks good, go ahead, following the feedback-learning versus decay proposal. Standing local CPU900s/max3 single-thread workers, own JRowe47/Super-1 branch/draft PR3, stable research scratch and compact project-folder checkpoints. No paid/GPU/cloud/language expansion.
authorization.approved_resources: Local CPU only; max3 concurrent one-thread children. No GPU/cloud/paid compute/external datasets. Restore same temporary pinned CPU runtime.
authorization.max_walltime: 15 minutes experiment execution; source preparation/dependency setup/artifact transfers excluded.
authorization.local_cpu_budget: 900 aggregate experiment process CPU seconds including runtime import canary, verification, pilot/main imports, warmup, diagnostics, full online replays, launchers and analysis. Child caps30+110+3*230=830 plus at most1s hard-limit grace per child.

design.mechanism_equations: RULE_MAPPING.md. W update unchanged. F_next=cap(F-0.05*(learning_on*g_F+decay_on*wd_F*F)), with independent boolean switches. Frozen neither; decay-only decay; learning-only local drive; normal adaptive both. Common warmup retains both components.

arms.backprop_fifo: Exact BP forward update; feedback unused/fixed.
arms.frozen_fifo: Local forward update; no feedback local update or feedback decay.
arms.decay_fifo: Local forward update; feedback decay only at original full rate, then cap.
arms.learning_fifo: Local forward update; feedback local drive at original full rate without feedback decay, then cap.
arms.adaptive_fifo: Original local forward+feedback learning+feedback decay, then cap.

design.control_rationale: 2x2 feedback learning on/off xdecay on/off after identical warmup, plus exact BP. Every arm shares FIFO512/16, current16, forward optimizer, replay IDs, data/query stream, model/start/exposure and one configuration. Primary normal adaptive vs decay-only distinguishes learned feedback from passive decay; all other contrasts descriptive.
design.seed_selection_method: Fresh consecutive main seeds1101821..3; separate pilot100917, new verification100917/15817/24817. Preserved reference verification retains its fixed seeds. No seed search, exclusions or selection.
design.matching_track: Same model/start/forward optimizer/replay/data/exposure and one configuration. Full original feedback rate; only two feedback update terms switched independently. Actual compute reported separately.
design.compute_accounting: Common warmup once per seed; imports, SVD caps in all updated-feedback arms, data regeneration, diagnostic exact gradients, all full online replays and analysis startup charged. Per-worker RSS; aggregate peak, FLOPs and deployment latency unmeasured.

training.state_carry_and_detach: Persistent forward/feedback matrices with detached stateless SGD, no optimizer/shadow state. Fixed feedback component switches; no phase or query input. Precomputed full streams/queries are benchmark bookkeeping, not deployed replay memory.
training.document_reset_policy: Not applicable: synthetic contexts, no documents.
training.optimizer_schedule: Forward lr0.05/WD0.001 unchanged. Base feedback-rule factor0.8 unchanged. Online feedback lr0.05; feedback WD B0.001,V/U0.01 independently enabled or disabled with feedback local learning. Full normal warmup for every arm. Spectral cap2 with margin1-4eps after any enabled feedback component; no cap for frozen feedback. No magnitude normalization or new rate trial.
training.checkpoint_selection_rule: No selection; all registered windows and final states. NPZ stores common warmup W/F, every final W, and final F for adaptive/learning-only/decay-only; BP/frozen F reference warmup. All4 phase/final complete-state hashes checked by full replay.

evaluation.primary_endpoint: Per-seed equal mean of novel CE at steps544..768 every32 and drift CE at1056..1280 every32 (16 checkpoints); arithmetic mean of three paired relative CE reductions.
evaluation.duplicate_policy: All5 arms for pilot and all3 main seeds repeat the complete online stream from serialized common warmup and regenerated/hash-verified FIFO data. All4 phase/final complete-state hashes plus stored final tensors must match bitwise.
evaluation.uncertainty_method: Three paired seeds, report every result, mean and sample SD. Descriptive evidence only; no significance or population claim.
evaluation.multiple_comparison_policy: Only adaptive_fifo vs decay_fifo is primary. Learning-only vs frozen, decay-only vs frozen, normal vs learning-only, and normal vs frozen are descriptive. Report difference-of-differences CE/accuracy interactions, per-seed gain decomposition, feedback displacement, novel/drift components and direction probes. No favorable comparator/rate selection; fractions are descriptive, not additive causal shares.

decision.reason: Apply the joint primary mechanism gate to normal adaptive versus decay-only after all3 fresh seeds and exact replay/preservation. Keep the original frozen-reference result visible.
decision.next_experiment: Decide from whether passive decay explains normal adaptation and whether learning-only or the interaction changes retention. No additional update rates, seeds or follow-on run within this experiment.
decision.promotion_scope: A primary pass supports only a bounded synthetic learned-feedback contribution beyond passive decay. It does not override normal-versus-frozen retention, establish original joint-objective success versus frozen, or authorize language/architecture promotion.
